dashboard.choosePlatformHelp: Hitamo urubuga rumwe. Kugenzura igikoresho no guhitamo icyo gupima biri ku rupapuro rukurikira.
dashboard.recentSessionsSimpleHelp: Komeza ikizamini giheruka cyangwa ufungure raporo yacyo.
dashboard.packagedUnavailable: Imiterere ya paki ntiboneka. Mu buryo bw'iterambere, tangiza pnpm dev:server.

error.failedToFetch: Ntibyashobotse guhuza na seriveri yo kuri iki gikoresho. Emeza ko sidecar ya desktop ikora, cyangwa utangize pnpm dev:server mu buryo bw'iterambere.
error.androidSystemScreenMessage: Telefoni iri kwerekana Igenamiterere rya Android cyangwa urupapuro rwa sisitemu. Fungura porogaramu cyangwa umukino ushaka kugerageza, hanyuma wongere ukande Tangira Ikizamini.
history.noRecentSessionsMessage: Tangira ikizamini cya Windows cyangwa Android kugira ngo amateka yuzure.
history.localOnly: Harerekanwa amateka yo kuri iki gikoresho gusa kuko local-server itaboneka.
guide.title: Uko ukoresha LumaTrace
guide.subtitle: Hitamo Windows cyangwa Android, ukurikize intambwe z'urubuga, utangize ikizamini, ugihagarike, hanyuma usome raporo.
guide.mockBody: Mock Local Device ni igikoresho cy'icyitegererezo cyubatswemo. Ibyo gipima bitanga ibipimo bya mock byanditse neza kugira ngo wige urugendo udahuje hardware.
guide.pcBody: PC yo kuri iki gikoresho yerekana porogaramu nyazo za Windows. Hitamo porogaramu imwe kugira ngo ukusanye CPU n'ububiko. FPS ikenera ifatwa rya PresentMon ryasabwe.
guide.androidBody: Kuri telefoni, fungura Amahitamo y'Utegura na USB debugging, wemerere iyi PC, ufungure porogaramu ushaka kugerageza, uyihitemo hano, hanyuma utangize isomo.
guide.deviceConcept: Igikoresho: inkomoko yo gukusanyaho, nko kuri iyi PC cyangwa telefoni ya Android.
guide.targetConcept: Icyo gupima: porogaramu, umukino, cyangwa prosesusi ushaka gupima kuri icyo gikoresho.
guide.sessionConcept: Isomo: igikorwa kimwe cyo gupima. Ritangize, urebe ibipimo, urihagarike, hanyuma ufungure raporo.
support.title: Kosora / Ohereza Ikibazo
support.body: Banza ugerageze kongera gutangiza mu mutekano no kongera kugenzura ibikoresho. Niba ikibazo gikomeza, fungura ifishi y'ikibazo ya GitHub yateguwe.
support.repairDescription: Ongera utangize ikusanya ryo kuri iki gikoresho kandi wongere ugenzure ibikoresho.
support.repairingHelp: Birimo kongera gutangiza ikusanya no kongera kugenzura ibikoresho.
support.repairFailed: Gukosora byikora ntibyarangiye. Ushobora kohereza ikibazo kugira ngo gikurikiranwe.
support.submitDescription: Fungura ifishi y'ikibazo ya GitHub yateguwe ku gukanda rimwe.
support.include: Ibisobanuro bifasha: verisiyo ya porogaramu, verisiyo ya Windows/Android, ubwoko bw'igikoresho, icyo wakanze, icyo wari utegereje, icyabaye, amashusho y'urupapuro, n'ibisohoka by'igenzura byasukuye.
support.privacy: Ntushyiremo token, konti, inzira zose zo kuri mudasobwa, inyandiko mbisi, dosiye CSV mbisi, logcat, bugreport, cyangwa amashusho y'ibanga.
device.mockDescription: Amakuru y'inyigisho atekanye. Ibipimo byakozwe kandi byanditse neza nka mock.
device.localPcDescription: Kuvumbura prosesusi nyazo za Windows no gupima CPU/ububiko.
session.beginnerBody: Ku kizamini cya mbere, hitamo Windows, hitamo prosesusi ya porogaramu ikora, ukande Tangira Ikizamini, uyihagarike nyuma y'amasegonda make, hanyuma ufungure raporo.
session.platformSubtitle: Tangira ku rubuga ushaka kugerageza. LumaTrace izakuyobora ku ntambwe ikurikira kandi ibipimo bitaboneka bizaguma N/A.
session.platformWindowsBody: Hitamo prosesusi ya porogaramu cyangwa umukino kuri iyi PC, hanyuma utangire ikizamini. Iyo prosesusi irangiye, isomo rirahagarara cyangwa rikandika ihagarara risobanutse.
session.platformAndroidBody: Fungura Amahitamo y'Utegura na USB debugging kuri telefoni, wemerere iyi PC, ufungure porogaramu ushaka kugerageza, hanyuma ukande Tangira Ikizamini. LumaTrace ivumbura paki iri imbere mu buryo bwikora.
session.runningHelp: Koresha porogaramu nk'uko bisanzwe. Soza ikizamini umaze gufata uko ibintu byari bimeze ushaka gupima.
session.defaultStep2: Kurikiza amabwiriza y'ihuza cyangwa guhitamo porogaramu ajyanye n'urubuga.
session.defaultStep3: Tangira ikizamini umaze guhitamo igikoresho n'icyo gupima.
session.choosePlatformFirstBody: Nyuma yo guhitamo Windows cyangwa Android, aha hazerekana gusa igikoresho, icyo gupima, n'igikorwa cyo gutangira by'urwo rubuga.
session.windowsStep2: Hitamo prosesusi ya porogaramu muri Icyo Gupima.
session.windowsStep3: Kanda Tangira Ikizamini. CPU, ububiko, FPS n'igihe cya frame bivugururwa ako kanya iyo PresentMon iboneka; bitabaye ibyo FPS iguma N/A.
session.androidStep1: Kuri telefoni ya Android, fungura Amahitamo y'Utegura, ufungure USB debugging, uhuze umugozi wa USB, kandi wemerere iyi PC.
session.androidStep2: Fungura porogaramu ushaka kugerageza kuri telefoni.
session.androidStep3: Kanda Tangira Ikizamini. LumaTrace ivumbura mu buryo bwikora paki ya porogaramu iri imbere kuri telefoni.
session.mockHint: Ibyo gupima bya mock ni ibyo kwiga urugendo gusa. Si ibipimo nyabyo by'igikoresho cyangwa porogaramu.
session.noTargetSelected: Hitamo icyo gupima mbere yo gutangira.
session.androidForegroundPending: Fungura porogaramu kuri telefoni, hanyuma ukande Tangira Ikizamini. Izina rya paki rizagaragara hano nyuma yo kuvumburwa.
session.windowsVisibleAppsHelp: Porogaramu zifunguye zerekanywa mbere. Ishakisha ribona na prosesusi zo inyuma.
session.noWindowsTargetMatches: Nta prosesusi ya Windows ihuye n'iri shakisha. Gerageza irindi zina cyangwa uvugurure ibyo gupima.
session.exportLogsToReportDir: Bika inyandiko mu bubiko bwa raporo
session.exportLogsToReportDirHelp: Android ibika ADB logcat yasukuye y'igihe cy'ikizamini. Windows ibika inyandiko z'isomo rya LumaTrace zifite igihe.
session.noWindowsTargets: Nta prosesusi ya porogaramu ya Windows ikora yavumbuwe. Fungura porogaramu cyangwa umukino ushaka kugerageza, hanyuma uvugurure urutonde rw'ibyo gupima.
session.noAndroidTargets: Nta porogaramu ya Android yo gupima iraboneka. Fungura Amahitamo y'Utegura na USB debugging, wemerere iyi PC, ufungure porogaramu kuri telefoni, hanyuma uvugurure.
device.title: Ibisobanuro by'Igikoresho
device.subtitle: Ibyo gupima n'ukuboneka kw'ibipimo ku gikoresho cya local-server cyahiswemo.
device.androidHelp: Android Beta ikenera Amahitamo y'Utegura n'uburenganzira bwa USB debugging. Ishyigikira kugenzura ubuzima bwa Tangiza Porogaramu / Hagarika Porogaramu ku buryo bweruye, igenzura ryo kongera guhuza prosesusi, n'imiterere ya cache/ubuzima yasukuye. Gupima CPU, ububiko, batiri na neti bikenera adb. FPS iracyari igerageza.
device.refreshAndroidCache: Vugurura cache ya metadata ya Android
device.pcHelp: PC Beta yerekana prosesusi za Windows zo kuri iki gikoresho kandi ishobora gupima CPU n'ububiko bihujwe na PID. FPS n'igihe cya frame bikenera PresentMon kandi biracyari igerageza; inzira za executable zirahishwa mbere yo kwerekanwa.
device.forceStopConfirm: Ibi bizahagarika ku gahato paki igamijwe kuri icyo gikoresho.
device.cacheRefreshed: Cache y'igikoresho cya Android n'iy'itangiza yavuguruwe.
session.title: Isomo ry'Ikizamini
session.subtitle: Hitamo urubuga, hitamo porogaramu cyangwa prosesusi yo gupima, tangira ikusanya, hanyuma uhagarike usome raporo.
session.deviceNetworkNotice: Imibare ya neti ku rwego rw'igikoresho ishobora kubamo urujya n'uruza rw'izindi porogaramu.
session.uidNetworkNotice: Imibare ya neti ku rwego rwa UID ibarwa ishingiye kuri dumpsys netstats detail.
session.androidNetworkNotice: Neti ya Android ikoresha netstats ku rwego rwa UID iyo iboneka, naho itaboneka igasubira ku mibare y'igikoresho n'ubunyangamugayo bwerekanwe.
session.androidFpsNotice: FPS/igihe cya frame cya Android ni igerageza kandi bigeragezwa mu kizamini hakoreshejwe imibare ya frame ya ADB rusange. Iyo Android itagaragaje amakuru ya frame ahuye, biguma N/A.
session.pcNotice: Ibizamini bya Windows bigerageza mu buryo bwikora FPS/igihe cya frame cya PresentMon ako kanya iyo PresentMon iboneka. CPU n'ububiko bikomeza gukora nubwo PresentMon itaboneka. Ukuboneka kwa PresentMon: {availability}.
session.sampleIntervalHelp: Imibare mito ikusanya kenshi kandi igatuma imirongo isa n'aho iri kuba ako kanya, ariko ikoresha CPU nyinshi. Imibare minini iroroshye kandi ikwiriye ibizamini birebire, ariko umurongo ntuba ufite ibisobanuro byinshi. 100 ms ni igenamiterere risanzwe ryiza.
session.reportOutputDirHelp: Hitamo aho raporo z'ibizamini zibikwa. Ikizamini kirangiye, LumaTrace yandika raporo za HTML, JSON na CSV muri ubu bubiko.
session.reportOutputDirUnavailable: Bizaboneka seriveri yo kuri iki gikoresho imaze gutangaza ububiko.
session.reportOutputDirChanged: Ububiko bwa raporo bwavuguruwe. Seriveri yo kuri iki gikoresho yongeye gutangizwa mu mutekano.
session.simpleSettingsHelp: Andi magenamiterere yose y'ikizamini akoresha ibisanzwe bitekanye. Ibipimo bibura biguma N/A kandi ntibisimbuzwa 0.
session.autoStart: Tangiza porogaramu igamijwe mu buryo bwikora
session.autoStartHelp: Tangiza Porogaramu mbere y'isomo igihe PID ibuze
session.monkeyFallbackHelp: Koresha monkey -p package 1 gusa igihe kuvumbura itangiza byanze
session.stopTarget: Hagarika icyo gupima igihe isomo rihagaze
session.stopTargetHelp: Hagarika ku gahato paki igamijwe nyuma y'ihagarara ry'isomo
session.experimentalFpsHelp: Fungura igenzura rya FPS ry'igerageza ryo mu gihe cyo guhagarika
session.presentMonEnableHelp: Kora ifatwa rya CSV rifite igihe gisobanutse rya FPS/igihe cya frame
session.presentMonKeepCsvHelp: Bika CSV y'agateganyo kugeza isomo risukuwe kugira ngo hakosorwe amakosa yo kuri iki gikoresho
session.androidFpsNaNotice: FPS n'igihe cya frame biguma N/A keretse igenzura ry'igerageza ritanga ibipimo bihuye n'icyo gupima. Layer zidasobanutse cyangwa zibura ntizihindurwa FPS.
session.pcCaptureNotice: Prosesusi yahiswemo ntitangizwa cyangwa ngo ihagarikwe na LumaTrace. Ifatwa rya PresentMon ni igerageza. Iyo nta mirongo ya PresentMon ihuye, FPS iguma N/A.
session.autoStopped: Porogaramu igamijwe yarangiye, bityo ikizamini gisozwa mu buryo bwikora kandi raporo yacyo ituzuye irabikwa.
session.restoreMissing: Isomo riheruka ntiryashoboye kwemezwa na local-server.
session.waitingForMetricsMessage: Birimo guhuza n'icyo gupima no gutegereza ibipimo nyabyo bya mbere. Imirongo izagaragara mu buryo bwikora amakuru ageze.
session.stopDialogMessage: Guhagarika bisohora ibipimo kandi bigakora raporo. Ntibizahanagura amateka yo kuri iki gikoresho.
session.createDialogMessage: Hari isomo ririmo gukora. Rihagarike mbere yo guhindura amasomo kugira ngo ikusanya rigume risobanutse.
report.title: Ibisubizo by'Ikizamini
report.subtitle: Hitamo igisubizo cy'ikizamini kugira ngo urebe FPS, 1% Low, igihe cya frame, CPU, ububiko, na raporo zasohowe.
report.deleteOneMessage: Siba {name} n'amakuru yacyo yakusanyijwe kuri iki gikoresho? Dosiye za raporo zasohowe zizagumaho.
report.deleteAllMessage: Siba ibisubizo by'ibizamini byo kuri iki gikoresho {count} byarangiye n'amakuru yabyo yakusanyijwe? Ibizamini birimo gukora na dosiye za raporo zasohowe bizagumaho.
report.recentResultsHelp: Hitamo ikizamini cyarangiye cyangwa cyahagaze kugira ngo urebe raporo yacyo.
report.noResultsMessage: Banza ukore ikizamini cya Windows cyangwa Android. Raporo izagaragara hano umaze guhagarika ikizamini.
report.coreMetricsHelp: Agaciro kabura kaguma N/A kandi ntigasimbuzwa 0.
report.performanceGroupHelp: Tangira hano: FPS yerekana kugenda neza, naho 1% Low n'igihe cya frame bikerekana ubushikame.
report.resourcesGroupHelp: CPU, GPU n'ububiko byakoreshejwe igihe iyi porogaramu cyangwa prosesusi yageragezwaga.
report.deviceGroupHelp: Amakuru y'ingufu, ubushyuhe bwa GPU, batiri na neti yakusanyijwe n'urubuga.
report.performancePoor: Impuzandengo ya FPS ni {avg}, munsi ya 30 FPS. Imikorere ni mibi kandi gukomwa birashoboka kugaragara.
report.performanceFair: Impuzandengo ya FPS ni {avg}, hagati ya 30 na 59.9 FPS. Imikorere iremewe, ariko ahantu hagoye hashobora kutagenda neza.
report.performanceGood: Impuzandengo ya FPS ni {avg}, 60 FPS cyangwa hejuru. Imikorere ni myiza kandi uburambe bugomba kugenda neza muri rusange.
report.performanceUnavailable: Impuzandengo ya FPS ntiyakusanyijwe, bityo iyi raporo ntishobora kugereranya imikorere yo kwerekana.
report.stabilityGood: 1% Low ni {onePercentLow} FPS ({ratio}% by'impuzandengo), bigaragaza ko gutanga frame gushikamye muri rusange.
report.stabilityNeedsAttention: 1% Low ni {onePercentLow} FPS ({ratio}% by'impuzandengo), bigaragaza ihindagurika ry'umuvuduko wa frame rigaragara.
report.stabilityUnavailable: Nta makuru ahagije ya 1% Low yo kugenzura ubushikame bw'umuvuduko wa frame.
report.performanceThresholdNote: Ibi byiciro bya FPS ni ubuyobozi rusange. Umupaka w'umuvuduko wa frame, igipimo cyo kuvugurura ekran, amagenamiterere y'amashusho, n'uko ikizamini cyakozwe bishobora guhindura ibisobanuro.
report.rawPreview: Raporo ngufi zikoresha ingero z'ibipimo mbisi mu kurebera mbere umurongo.
report.downsampledPreview: Raporo ndende zikoresha impuzandengo z'amatsinda mu kurebera mbere umurongo. Ibisohoka mbisi ntibihinduka.
report.noTrendDataMessage: Imirongo ya FPS, igihe cya frame, CPU n'ububiko iguma N/A iyo nta ngero z'imibare ziboneka.
report.exportHelp: Iki kizamini cyamaze {duration}. Ingero z'ibipimo mbisi {metrics} ziraboneka ngo zisohorwe.
report.noPresentMon: Nta makuru ya FPS ya PresentMon
report.noPresentMonMessage: FPS n'igihe cya frame biguma N/A iyo ifatwa rizimye, ribura, ridahuye, cyangwa ridasobanutse.
report.presentMonNotice: Ifatwa rya PresentMon rirasobanutse kandi ni igerageza. Raporo ntizirimo ibiri muri CSV mbisi cyangwa inzira zuzuye z'ibisohoka byo kuri mudasobwa.
report.diagnosticsNotice: Ibisohoka byarasukuwe kandi ntibirimo ibiva muri logcat cyangwa bugreport.
tools.title: Ibikoresho / Igenzura
tools.subtitle: Imiterere y'ibikoresho bya Android na Windows n'igenzura mu mwanya umwe wo kuri iki gikoresho wasukuye.
tools.securityNotice: ADB cyangwa PresentMon bishobora kubura porogaramu igakomeza gukora. Logcat, bugreport, root, kohereza mu gicu, n'ikizamini cya monkey gisanzwe bikomeza kuzimwa.
tools.toolAction.adbAvailable: Huza igikoresho cya Android gifite USB debugging ifunguye.
tools.toolAction.adbInstall: Shyiramo Android SDK Platform Tools kandi utume adb iboneka.
tools.toolAction.presentMonAvailable: Fungura PresentMon gusa igihe amakuru ya FPS ya Windows cyangwa igihe cya frame akenewe.
tools.toolAction.presentMonInstall: Shyiramo PresentMon cyangwa ugene inzira yayo yo kuri mudasobwa kugira ngo ifatwa rya FPS ya Windows rikore.
tools.toolAction.checkConfiguration: Genzura ishyirwamo ry'igikoresho n'igenamiterere ryo kuri mudasobwa.
tools.noPcDevice: Nta gikoresho cya PC cyo kuri iyi mudasobwa
tools.noPcDeviceMessage: Imiterere ya PresentMon igaragara igihe igikoresho cya PC kiboneka.
tools.presentMonDefaultReason: Ifatwa rya PresentMon rirasobanutse kandi ni igerageza.
tools.presentMonLimit.explicit: Ifatwa rya PresentMon rigomba gufungurwa ku buryo bweruye kandi rikomeza kuba igerageza.
tools.presentMonLimit.noMatch: FPS iguma N/A igihe icyo gupima kidashobora guhuzwa kimwe gusa.
tools.presentMonLimit.privacy: LumaTrace ntirenga ku burenganzira bwa Windows cyangwa ngo ishyire CSV mbisi muri raporo.
tools.presentMonLimit.other: PresentMon yatanze indi mbogamizi yo guhuza.
packaging.localServer: Gupakira Seriveri yo Kuri Iki Gikoresho
packaging.statusUnavailableMessage: Uburyo bw'iterambere bushobora gukomeza gukoresha pnpm dev:server.
packaging.check2: Bearer token irakenewe kuri REST na WebSocket bipakiwe.
packaging.check3: Token ntibikwa muri VITE variables, localStorage, URL, inyandiko, raporo, cyangwa igenzura.
packaging.check4: Kongera gutangiza sidecar bifite umupaka kandi igenzura ry'igihombo rirasukurwa.
packaging.check5: Kuzengurutsa inyandiko kwafunguwe ku nyandiko za porogaramu na sidecar.
packaging.check6: Ikizamini smoke cy'ububiko bupakiwe cyemeza kongera gukoresha DB nyuma yo kongera gutangiza.
packaging.check7: Manifesiti z'imenyesha ryo gupakira zirakorwa kandi ziracyakeneye isuzuma ryo gusohora.
packaging.check8: Kwitegura gusohora paki ya Windows kuguma kubujijwe kugeza amarembo y'umusaruro arangiye.
packaging.check9: Gusinya kw'umusaruro, updater, notarization, no gukwirakwiza mu iduka ntibiragenwa.
packaging.rcNotice: Iyi ncamake ihuza kwitegura kwa sidecar, QA ya GUI ikozwe n'intoki, politiki yo gusohora, n'ibimenyetso by'amarembo ya RC mu ishusho imwe yasukuye. Si ukwemererwa gusohora, kandi productionReady iguma false.

metricQuality.body: Ibipimo bitaboneka biguma N/A kandi ntibisimbuzwa 0. Amakuru y'icyitegererezo yanditse nka mock.

presentMon.permissionsBody: FPS y'ako kanya ikenera uburenganzira bwo gukurikirana imikorere ya Windows rimwe. LumaTrace ubwayo ikomeza gukora nta burenganzira bw'umuyobozi, kandi CPU/ububiko bikomeza kuboneka nta burenganzira bwa FPS.
session.fpsAccessBody: CPU n'ububiko birakora ubu. Fungura gukurikirana imikorere ya Windows rimwe kugira ngo wongeremo FPS n'igihe cya frame.
session.fpsAccessRestartBody: Sohoka muri Windows hanyuma wongere winjire rimwe. Ibizamini byo mu gihe kizaza bizakora nta burenganzira bw'umuyobozi.
session.fpsAccessErrorBody: CPU n'ububiko biracyaboneka. Gerageza kongera kugenzura.
session.fpsAccessCancelledBody: Nta cyahindutse. Komeza na CPU n'ububiko, cyangwa ufungure FPS nyuma.
presentMon.retentionBody: Raporo ntizigera zirimo ibiri muri CSV mbisi ya PresentMon. Inzira zo kuri mudasobwa zirasukurwa mbere yo kugaragara mu igenzura cyangwa raporo.
presentMon.noStatusBody: Rema cyangwa utangize ikizamini cya Windows kugira ngo urebe imiterere y'ifatwa.
presentMon.defaultReason: Ifatwa rya PresentMon rirasobanutse kandi ni igerageza. FPS isohoka gusa nyuma yo guhuza icyo gupima neza.
pc.sourcePrecision: FPS ya Windows n'igihe cya frame biva mu ifatwa rya CSV rya PresentMon ryasabwe kandi bikomeza kuba igerageza. CPU n'ububiko bikomeza igihe PresentMon ibuze cyangwa itagaruye amakuru.
android.fallbackNetwork: Imibare ya neti ku rwego rw'igikoresho ishobora kubamo urujya n'uruza rw'izindi porogaramu.
android.fpsExperimental: Kuvumbura FPS ya Android ni igerageza.
